label: Loss curve
intent: Training lowers the loss. Light: the latest loss point drops ten units in one move and stops dead, the trace bending down with it, while a faint copy of the old point stays behind for a moment and fades, showing how far it fell. Strong: two training steps: the point drops most of the way, pauses, then drops the rest; the old point lingers longer. The loss is data and never overshoots; the axes never move.

previous.//: hidden at rest: the old loss point, left behind while the new one drops

trace.//: the trace's end stays on the point: both move by the same eased keys

endpoint.y.//: the same keys as drop, times 10 (v1's end state: 10 units down)

reverse.//: restoring the old loss: the point rises at once along the same path; nothing is left behind
